AC1.requirement: A scheduled agent reads persona performance and health evidence through existing read APIs and proposes promote or demote transitions only by creating governance approval requests of type persona lifecycle transition with the evidence and rationale
AC1.finding: Merged PR #6086 (head 3bd15f871b460a7f5daca384202f4754a4176774, merge ac4fed216131398143417f1d02b310ba72f7b825) delivers collect_evidence() reading GET /bff/management/quarterly-ranking and propose_lifecycle() submitting POST /api/governance/approvals with target_type=persona_lifecycle_transition, proposal_id, proposal_content_digest, and validation_result_digest only for supported lifecycle transitions. Current natural run persona-eval-20261021T143037Z at 2026-10-21T14:30:37.484541+00:00 evaluated source snapshot ranking-quarterly-2026-q4-902d0455fbb26af2009b83a3 with 13/13 ranking surfaces ok (HTTP 200) and saved 1 advisory item (action_id=require_retraining, governance_request=null).

AC2.requirement: The agent is given no tool that changes persona or capital or runtime state and cannot decide its own requests
AC2.finding: ask_agent() calls only /api/openclaw-adapter/assistant/providers/openclaw/structured with RECOMMENDATIONS_SCHEMA (data-only structured extraction, all native tools denied). The process holds only viewer read and approval_proposer tokens and has no endpoint or code path to decide, approve, revoke, or apply governance decisions or mutate persona, capital, or runtime state.

AC3.requirement: Requests are deduplicated per persona and target state and rate limited
AC3.finding: run_once() enforces MAX_PER_RUN=5, MAX_PER_HOUR=20 rolling-hour persisted reservation slots, and DEDUPE_TTL_SECONDS=604800 (7 days) per persona_id|to_state with deterministic Idempotency-Key and decision_id bound to persona, transition states, snapshot_id, and proposal_content_digest.

AC4.requirement: When evidence or the agent is unavailable the run is recorded as degraded and creates nothing
AC4.finding: Degraded exceptions on missing/unavailable/changing ranking evidence, snapshot admission failure, or unavailable/malformed agent output record last_run={status:'degraded', created:0} in Store without creating recommendations or governance proposals.

AC5.requirement: Tests cover dedupe and rate limit and degraded runs and the absence of write tools
AC5.finding: Independently verified in functional review of PR #6086 (3bd15f871b460a7f5daca384202f4754a4176774): services/persona-evaluator-agent/test_persona_evaluator_agent.py (14 passed) plus BFF projection/mounted ranking/governance suites (50 + 72 passed).

AC6.requirement: This is the sole persona recommendation evaluator; replace the old BFF recommendation source in the same delivery rather than running a second recommendation engine next to it
AC6.finding: services/persona-evaluator-agent is the sole recommendation producer; the legacy BFF score-threshold recommendation engine was removed in the same PR #6086 delivery.

AC7.finding: _pm12_recommendation_action_ids, _pm12_add_recommendation_action, and static rationale formatting in services/control-plane/bff/pm12/service.py and services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py were deleted in PR #6086; _pm12_quarterly_recommendations projects saved evaluator items from evaluator_results.saved_evaluator_result() filtered by caller tenant visibility.

AC8.requirement: Preserve deterministic performance/risk/eligibility scores and fixed formulas as read-only evidence; the evaluator judges supported recommendations with source references and an actual provider rationale; read surfaces and Human Inbox reuse that saved result rather than regenerating it
AC8.finding: Deterministic ranking scores, tiers, eligibility, and evidence_refs remain read-only inputs; ask_agent() requires supported action_id, non-empty provider rationale, and evidence_ref_ids subset of the persona's supplied refs. BFF ranking recommendations, promotion review submit, and Human Inbox read the saved evaluator result without recomputing.

AC9.requirement: Only supported lifecycle recommendations create the existing governance lifecycle approval request; other existing advisory categories may remain as persisted non-executable report entries; do not invent budget/tool/capital write capabilities or reinterpret those categories as lifecycle targets
AC9.finding: LIFECYCLE_TARGETS maps only freeze_persona->frozen and retire_persona->retired when allowed by LIFECYCLE_TRANSITIONS. Advisory actions (including require_retraining observed in natural run persona-eval-20261021T143037Z with governance_request=null) persist as non-executable report entries with no governance proposal or budget/tool/capital write.

AC10.requirement: Reuse the evaluator run-result persistence already needed for degraded runs and existing governance requests; persist persona and period/source-snapshot identity so refresh/retry/restart reads the same recommendation; no second advisory service or queue and no heuristic recommendation fallback when the provider is unavailable
AC10.finding: Store persists results keyed by quarter|ranking_snapshot_id with bounded retention (MAX_SNAPSHOTS_KEPT=20; current retained_snapshot_count=20, observer_model_calls=0 on readback) alongside requests, created timestamps, and last_run in one state file; evaluator_results.py returns None with no heuristic fallback when unavailable.

AC11.finding: Mounted ranking and projection suites (test_persona_evaluator_mounted_ranking.py, test_persona_evaluator_projection.py) and independent review probe verified persisted provider recommendation reuse across ranking, submit, and Human Inbox, prove high/low score alone produces no recommendation without saved evaluator output, and keep fixed score regressions green.
